item_short_desc: Ben's 30 Tick & Insect Repellent offers reliable protection against ticks and insects that may carry harmful diseases such as West Nile Virus, Lyme disease, Malaria, Eastern Equine Encephalitis, and Zika Virus. With a 30% DEET formula, this water-based repellent provides up to 8 hours of effective defense, ensuring your skin stays protected throughout the day. The water-based formulation remains on the skin's surface rather than being absorbed, providing long-lasting protection without the sticky residue.
description: Ben's 30 Tick & Insect Repellent offers reliable protection against ticks and insects that may carry harmful diseases such as West Nile Virus, Lyme disease, Malaria, Eastern Equine Encephalitis, and Zika Virus. With a 30% DEET formula, this water-based repellent provides up to 8 hours of effective defense, ensuring your skin stays protected throughout the day. The water-based formulation remains on the skin's surface rather than being absorbed, providing long-lasting protection without the sticky residue. Fragrance-free, Ben's 30 is ideal for those with sensitive skin or who prefer unscented products. Its TSA-compliant 3.4oz travel size allows you to carry the maximum amount of insect repellent with you wherever you go, ensuring you're always prepared.
